svg.title: Inside the BMC: programs, D-Bus and bmcweb
svg.text: Inside the BMC: the programs, the D-Bus that connects them, and bmcweb
The BMC is a small Linux computer running ~30 cooperating programs. They never call each other directly: everything goes as messages over D-Bus.
1. WHAT IS RUNNING ON THE BOARD
"Front doors": programs that talk to the outside world. bmcweb turns web/Redfish requests into D-Bus messages (part 3).
D-Bus system bus (the program dbus-broker; socket /run/dbus/system_bus_socket)
Every program connects to it once, claims a NAME, and from then on sends and receives messages by name. Like a switchboard: all traffic goes through it.
